in_marathi.name: Isteyak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Isteyak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Isteyak is a name of Hindu origin, derived from the Sanskrit word 'istikaya' meaning 'sacrifice, offering'. This name reflects the spiritual significance of selflessness, generosity, and devotion.
